hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */lint-fixtures/*) ;; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm exec prettier --write --ignore-unknown --log-level warn "$f" 1>&2 && pnpm exec oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$f" 1>&2 || exit 2 ;; esac
